collection.title: Smart ForFour 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Smart ForFour 2014 Onwards model requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this ForFour, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
